ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels constituting approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted with low-intensity (black) pixels along the perimeter and internal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region across both lobes. Low-intensity black border tracing the trailing edge and tips. Multiple vertical black linear streaks (mottling) distributed across the central and outer lobes. Three small dark circular spots located in the lower-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 130 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with high-frequency, low-amplitude variations (5-10 pixels) punctuated by several macro-peaks along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, multi-tonal (white/tan/grey) circular clusters representing barnacle colonization at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal black linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths (10-60 pixels) across the white field of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters on distal tips; significant linear scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dynamic water splash/spray obscuring the lower-inner portion of the right lobe's ventral surface.
